review_type: Independent read-only source diagnosis, offline fakes, and prospective architecture assessment
scope: No repository source/docs, production, settings, money controls, history or sealed research changes. Private harness/output only; cloud runtime context read without credential values.
production_evidence: PR62 fixed capture establishes explicit-slug causes, aggregate flags true, fresh BTC, V1 zero forecasts/scored. No unique producer branch/occurrence time was retained; source fakes do not attribute the actual captured gaps.

findings.kind: Intentional V1 admission semantics, not a false gap
evidence: speeddesk_kalshi_ws.py:331-335: makers require a trade in previous 3 seconds; losing membership emits explicit gap even with fresh books
speeddesk_venues.py:31-42: venue-local gap survives composite healthy flags
kalshi_online_learning.py:161-171,263-270: V1 stores the gap and rejects the due slot
speeddesk_model.py:213-233: fair_up depends on spot/strike/sigma/horizon, not maker-tape eligibility
findings.reproduction: quiet_trade_expiry: connected timestamped WS book age0, trade age4, Coinbase connected, composite stream true, due BTC age0.2, p0.5 available; actual V1 unknown/pregap1, forecasts0. Legitimate V1 history stays intact.

findings.kind: Source-proven observation chronology defect, production frequency unknown
evidence: kalshi_arena.py:613-614: g has no event timestamp
kalshi_arena.py:1491-1530: drain uses current application time
findings.reproduction: Actual parent feed_gap at999, healthy recovery also999, child receives/drains1000.1 for window start1000: V1 pregap. Identical V1 direct event-time calls999 ignore prestart gap and forecast at1300.
findings.smallest_correct_fix: Separately scoped timestamped producer gap observation carried to child and used for learner event chronology, preserving FIFO and simulator cancellation at application time. Unknown/legacy/invalid/skewed stamps fail closed; occurrence time cannot be inferred from frame-send clock. This is deferred by root, not silently repaired through V2.

findings.kind: Source-proven unconditional late invalidation; usefulness for admission not established
evidence: speeddesk_kalshi.py:285-290: success path checks current fresh WS before applying REST
speeddesk_kalshi.py:291-294: exception path unconditionally clears marker and emits explicit gap
findings.reproduction: Awaited REST poll starts without fresh WS; synthetic recovery gives fresh WS/active websocket transport while request waits; REST then times out and publishes book_unavailable explicit slug despite healthy makers.
findings.smallest_correct_fix: A separately reviewed error supersession check must require fresh current WS evidence and relevant transport; avoid late failure clearing a valid recovered source. Preserve failure when source missing/stale or continuity uncertain. Tape failure needs stronger sequence/trade freshness evidence, not cached maker list.
findings.limit: Prior real continuity loss/transport gap may already exclude window. Suppressing this additional late marker does not prove the window is eligible or fix all samples.

recommended_prospective_work.decision: Separate V2 probability-quality observer is justified as a prospective new protocol. It is not a repair of upstream gaps and does not turn V1 unknowns into forecasts.
boundary: New module/class, protocol, fingerprint, state/panel/log keys; no copied or migrated V1 counts, pending forecasts, bins, labels or unknowns. Preserve V1 source/fingerprint and existing hooks/results.
Fixed300-second slot with existing5-second grace and first-due outcome finality. Discover prestart; no late/backfilled forecast. Same bin10/prior20 prequential score-before-update math.

Require finite positive verified Kalshi venue_start_price equal to start_price, consistent 900-second terms, current finite positive BTC with0<=age<=3, finite nonnegative qualified sigma, finite valid fresh batch age<=3, no known raw sequence/drop since start.

Raw parent/child corruption and lost frame/drop remain exclusions; maker/book/REST availability cannot be interpreted as absent probability inputs. Their annotation must not drive V2 admission implicitly.

Validate raw labels before bool coercion; reject early/malformed/conflicting/timeout labels and term changes before scoring, preserve out-of-order official settlements and future-watermark independence.
Independent optional error boundary, restore checks, no control/order interfaces. Add state under independent optional key to existing cadence; no new parent/wire work or fsync.
State explicitly whether a current Coinbase disconnect with still-fresh observed BTC is eligible. Do not silently inherit trade_stream conjunction.
recommended_prospective_work.quality_limit: BitcoinTape.sigma (speeddesk_model.py:339-350) requires3600-second warmup/1500 adjacent returns and skips gaps. Finite sigma proves its existing qualification, not complete3600-second coverage. Existing snapshots expose no full-history certification.
recommended_prospective_work.fingerprint_limit: Plain subclassing OnlineLearning is unsafe: methods close over module-global PROTOCOL, fingerprint and logger names. New protocol identity must describe every reused dependency; exact deployed source still needed for child-hook identity.
regressions: quiet maker expiry with fresh conditional probability inputs: V1 remains pregap while V2 prospective forecast/official score is independent
invalid/missing/disagreeing strike, NaN/negative sigma, stale/future BTC, missing/stale/future batch, reversed clock all reject without later cherry-pick
raw sequence and drop before/after/start-boundary; drop before w same-frame; legacy batch metadata missing; no manufactured continuity
same-frame terms+label in both orderings, early label, malformed original bool, duplicate/conflicting labels, delayed official labels and timeouts
restart with old V1-only state starts new V2 history without copying; malformed V2 state disables only V2; V1 serialized state and counts remain exact across traces
failure injection in V2 constructor/method/log/restore cannot change V1 or residents/accounting/save cadence
bounded pending/recent/labels and measured child CPU/state overhead; protected source bytes remain identical; regression tests before release
recommended_prospective_work.release_claim: A future qualified V2 forecast/score proves operation on its declared cohort only. It does not prove calibration improvement, trading profitability, upstream continuity or closure of EXEC.
